dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Eyes... so heavy. Tired... but it's bright out?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: ...Branches are swaying. Leaves are so shiny... eyes hurt.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey, Razor! Razor, are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, Razor! I... I didn't think that you were the one who ate my bait...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Yeah. My dad's only just recovered, and I wanted him to get some more rest, so I've been using new traps to hunt.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Did not know, those were traps. Thought they were gifts... from Springvale. So, I took.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Cold Cut Platter very good. Drinks, good. Carrot-flavored Valberry, good.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Calla Lily, vegetable. Gave it to my friend.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If I may... Which friend are you referring to?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Oh, no... I've really done it now. First Razor, now Bennett... and Sucrose's experimental results are a bust, too.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's okay. Your friends will understand.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Ugh. I'm never using traps to hunt ever again!
